description: Search AgentGid for agents, coding tools, APIs, models and stacks that fit a goal, e.g. 'Solana LP copy-trading bot', 'web search API for a research agent under $50/month', 'animate a 2D game UI', 'free fonts for a mobile app'. Returns candidates grouped by kind (libraries and tools, content assets, agents, APIs, guides) with Gid Score, prices, licenses and links. Use this first, then get_tool / get_asset / get_api / get_agent for the full card. For a whole website or AI product the answer's start_here names the design recipe, product recipe or project kit to call first. Goals in Russian work too.

embed_ok.description: For a product you offer to others (a generator, app or hosted service): only libraries whose license lets you ship them in a closed product (permissive or weak copyleft) and content sources whose terms let you pass the files on to your users

goal.description: What the user wants to build or do, in plain words

name: find_tools
title: Find tools for a goal
